Affine independent check errors: 12.14 m, 15.05 m. Does not meet the 5 m registration gate; conservative source-constrained estimates only. Northern row, western red roof and southern classroom row enclose a predominantly bare yard. Lawn only in visible peripheral green patches. Imagery-to-OSM disagreements are clipped to complete mapped obstacles; no surveyed boundary, species, court markings, construction date or exact inventory inferred. No bitmap ships.
